name: streamlit-pdf-viewer
description: Streamlit custom component for PDF viewing with chunk overlays

scripts.build:pdf-viewer: vite build --config vite.config.pdf-viewer.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('build/index-pdf-viewer.html','utf8'); const fixedHtml=html.replace('src=\"/index-pdf-viewer.js\"','src=\"index-pdf-viewer.js\"'); fs.writeFileSync('build/index-pdf-viewer.html', fixedHtml); fs.mkdirSync('build/pdf-viewer', {recursive: true}); if(fs.existsSync('build/index-pdf-viewer.js')) fs.copyFileSync('build/index-pdf-viewer.js', 'build/pdf-viewer/index-pdf-viewer.js'); if(fs.existsSync('build/pdf-viewer.es.js')) fs.copyFileSync('build/pdf-viewer.es.js', 'build/pdf-viewer/pdf-viewer.es.js'); const pdfViewerHtml=html.replace('src=\"/index-pdf-viewer.js\"','src=\"index-pdf-viewer.js\"'); fs.writeFileSync('build/pdf-viewer/index.html', pdfViewerHtml);"
